role: independent packet verifier — built none of these packets
obligationSetNote: Every subject is scored against the factory's canonical fifteen, each obligation named and scored individually, per lane contract L9. A first pass of this lane scored a narrower seven-item set and claimed PASS_COMPLETE_INDEPENDENT over it; the coordinator caught that against L9 and this return replaces it. Two verdicts changed on the wider reading, and both changes are recorded below rather than argued away.
method: Per family: claim asserted before reading; MASTER_QUEUE row and overlay directory located; verify-packet-completeness.mjs re-run in this container and read directly; committed reports read against the fixtures; fixture PDFs rehashed against rendered-artifacts.json; every source PDF rehashed from the Master Library bytes mounted at private/source-imports/Expungement_AI_RCAP_Master_Library_Edition_1 against source-receipt.json and the committed corpus index; participant writes proven in the fixture bytes, with pdftotext re-reads wherever the committed readback dropped a character or returned empty; page order checked against pdfinfo page counts and the declared manifest; route elections, repeating rows and protected fields checked in the field map and the byte proof; the four participant-facing obligations (FILING_DESTINATION, FEE_AND_WAIVER, SERVICE, SELF_HELP_STOP) read out of each family's participant-instructions.md in full rather than pattern-matched; RASTER_QUEUE receipts checked hash-bound to the same bytes; repaired families checked against the prior FAIL findings defect by defect.

The fifteen also surface two real defects its siblings do not have: FILING_DESTINATION FAIL (no 'Where you file this' section at all) and SERVICE FAIL (no service statement, while the stipulation-signature step is present — a participant could take the prosecutor's signature for service).

CHANGED from the narrower first pass. FEE_AND_WAIVER FAIL: participant-instructions.md never addresses cost anywhere — no amount, no statement that there is no fee, no office to ask. I decoded the form's shifted page-1 font myself and found no fee statement on the face either, so the likely truth is that nothing is charged; but the packet does not say so, and a participant cannot tell 'no fee' from 'not mentioned'. The other fourteen pass, including an unusually strong SELF_HELP_STOP (the signature also requests DNA Databank expungement — do not sign until you have asked the Bureau). Repair assignment written to vf09/repair-assignments.json.

All fifteen pass. TF-800 under Administrative Rule 37.6, 3 pages hash-bound to source; two operative stops — the 90-day window to check before filing, and the redirect to TF-810 where the case is public by mistake.

CHANGED from the narrower first pass, and capped rather than failed. Fourteen obligations pass — including a $0 fee with its authority, a filing destination that carries the closed-location chart, and correct fact binding despite the documented shared caption-channel defect, which the family contains by refusing affected fields by role. SERVICE is NOT_MEASURABLE_HERE: the family's own reports/local-filing-variation.json records serviceMethod as not recorded in any held source, with the form carrying no service block and the compiled CT profile's serviceAndNoticeRules empty, and states that an absent record is not a finding that no service is required. Refusing to invent a service rule is right, so this is not a packet defect — but an unmeasured obligation caps the verdict at PASS.

verdictChangesFromTheFirstPass.because: FEE_AND_WAIVER was not in the narrower obligation set. Measured on the wider one, the packet does not answer what the request costs.
SERVICE was not in the narrower obligation set. Measured on the wider one it cannot be resolved from any held source, and a row carrying an unmeasured obligation may not claim the strongest verdict.

handoffs.what: CT's service open question is recorded where the participant cannot see it
handoffs.detail: The family honestly records service as unresolved in reports/local-filing-variation.json, but participant-instructions.md never raises it. Its siblings surface such open questions to the participant with the office to ask. Not scored as a defect — the underlying rule is genuinely unestablished — but it is the difference between this row and a complete one.

claims: All 12 subjects asserted before reading and released after verdicts were recorded (grant set 573bba8a85de8544).
grantsNothing: An independent PASS proves a packet is complete. It approves no output, opens no commercial route, and creates no fulfillment record. A FAIL is a verdict and a repair assignment, never an edit: this lane wrote into no overlay directory and no build script.
